IGUI_DazedGuide_PlumbPanel_Text: A connected water main has a Water panel (right-click the main). <LINE> <LINE> SUPPLY shows what reached the house last minute, DEMAND what its fixtures want. Click the left or right half of LINE RATE to lower or raise the house's share. <LINE> <LINE> Each fixture has a valve and arrows for the fill order: the first in line fills first when water is short. Sources on the line can be switched on and off, and their flow stepped. <LINE> <LINE> The MAIN SHUT-OFF wheel needs two clicks within two seconds; tick DRAIN FIXTURES ON SHUT-OFF to empty the house when it closes. Lamps show TAINTED, DRY, RATIONED and PAUSED (frozen pipes pause it too). <LINE> <LINE> Build a Water Panel and hang it on a wall inside the house to use the board from indoors. It binds to the main that serves the building; until one does, its menu says so.
